name: PM Kisan Samman Nidhi
description: PM Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN) is a central government scheme that provides income support of ₹6,000 per year to all land-holding farmer families across the country. The amount is paid in three equal instalments of ₹2,000 each directly to the bank accounts of farmers.
benefits: ₹6,000 per year (₹2,000 every 4 months) directly in bank account via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT)

eligibility.description: All land-holding farmer families with cultivable land, subject to certain exclusions
additionalCriteria: Must own agricultural land
Must have valid bank account
Aadhaar must be linked

applicationProcess: Visit the official PM-KISAN portal: pmkisan.gov.in
Click on 'New Farmer Registration' under Farmers Corner
Enter Aadhaar Number and State
Fill in personal details and land records
Submit the form and note the reference number
Visit Common Service Centre (CSC) for verification if needed

name: Ayushman Bharat - PMJAY
hindiName: आयुष्मान भारत - प्रधानमंत्री जन आरोग्य योजना
description: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY) is the world's largest government health insurance scheme. It provides health coverage of ₹5 lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization to over 10 crore poor and vulnerable families.
benefits: Health coverage of ₹5 lakh per family per year for hospitalization expenses at empanelled hospitals

eligibility.description: Poor and vulnerable families based on SECC 2011 database and defined occupation categories
additionalCriteria: Must be in SECC 2011 database
Rural deprivation criteria
Urban occupational criteria

applicationProcess: Check eligibility at pmjay.gov.in or call 14555
Visit nearest Common Service Centre (CSC) or Ayushman Mitra at empanelled hospital
Get your Ayushman Card generated with Aadhaar verification
Show Ayushman Card at any empanelled hospital for cashless treatment
Treatment is completely cashless and paperless

name: PM Awas Yojana
description: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana aims to provide affordable housing to the urban and rural poor. Under PMAY-Urban, financial assistance is provided to EWS/LIG/MIG households. Under PMAY-Gramin, financial assistance is provided for construction of pucca houses in rural areas.
benefits: Financial assistance up to ₹2.67 lakh (Urban EWS/LIG) and up to ₹1.30 lakh (Rural) for house construction

eligibility.description: EWS (annual income up to ₹3 lakh), LIG (₹3-6 lakh), MIG-I (₹6-12 lakh), MIG-II (₹12-18 lakh)
additionalCriteria: Should not own a pucca house anywhere in India
House must be in applicant's or co-applicant's name (preferably woman)
Must be first-time homebuyer for MIG category

applicationProcess: Visit pmaymis.gov.in for urban or pmayg.nic.in for rural
Check your eligibility based on income category
Register online or visit nearest CSC/ULB office
Fill the application form with required details
Submit documents for verification
Track application status on the official portal

name: MGNREGA
hindiName: महात्मा गांधी राष्ट्रीय ग्रामीण रोजगार गारंटी अधिनियम
description: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (MGNREGA) guarantees 100 days of unskilled manual wage employment per financial year to every rural household whose adult members volunteer to do unskilled manual work.
benefits: 100 days of guaranteed wage employment per financial year at minimum wages (₹220-₹350/day depending on state)

eligibility.description: Any adult member of a rural household willing to do unskilled manual work
additionalCriteria: Must be a rural resident
Must be willing to do unskilled manual work
Job card registration required

applicationProcess: Get a Job Card from the Gram Panchayat
Submit written application for work to Gram Panchayat
Work must be provided within 15 days of application
If work is not provided within 15 days, unemployment allowance is paid
Wages are directly transferred to bank/post office account

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana
description: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana is a small deposit savings scheme for the girl child. The scheme can be opened in the name of a girl child below 10 years by a guardian. It offers high interest rates (currently 8.2%) and tax benefits under Section 80C.
benefits: High interest rate of 8.2% p.a., Tax deduction under Section 80C, Tax-free maturity amount. Account matures 21 years from date of opening.

eligibility.description: For girl children below 10 years of age at the time of account opening
additionalCriteria: Girl child must be below 10 years
Maximum 2 accounts per family (3 in case of twins)
Minimum deposit ₹250 per year

applicationProcess: Visit nearest Post Office or authorized bank
Fill Sukanya Samriddhi Account Opening Form
Submit required documents
Make initial deposit (minimum ₹250, maximum ₹1.5 lakh per year)
Collect passbook and account details

name: PM Ujjwala Yojana
description: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY) aims to provide free LPG connections to women from BPL households, safeguarding the health of women and children from indoor kitchen pollution and reducing drudgery associated with the collection of firewood.
benefits: Free LPG connection with first cylinder and pressure regulator, Financial assistance of ₹1,600 per connection

eligibility.description: Women above 18 years from BPL households not already having an LPG connection
additionalCriteria: Must be a woman applicant
Household should not have existing LPG connection
Must have BPL ration card or be in SECC list

applicationProcess: Visit nearest LPG distributor
Fill the KYC form for Ujjwala Yojana
Submit required documents
Get EMI loan for stove and first refill if needed
Receive free LPG connection

name: PM Jan Dhan Yojana
description: Pradhan Mantri Jan-Dhan Yojana (PMJDY) is a financial inclusion scheme ensuring access to financial services like banking accounts, remittance, credit, insurance, and pension. Every unbanked person gets a zero-balance bank account.
benefits: Zero-balance savings account, RuPay debit card, ₹1 lakh accident insurance, ₹30,000 life insurance, 10,000 overdraft facility

eligibility.description: Any unbanked Indian citizen above 10 years of age
additionalCriteria: Must not have a bank account already
Valid ID proof required

documents: Voter ID or Passport or Driving License
applicationProcess: Visit nearest bank branch or business correspondent
Fill the account opening form
Submit KYC documents
Account is opened immediately
Receive RuPay debit card and passbook

name: National Pension Scheme (NPS)
description: National Pension System (NPS) is a voluntary, long-term retirement savings scheme designed to enable systematic savings during the subscriber's working life. It offers market-linked returns through regulated fund managers.
benefits: Tax benefits under Section 80C and 80CCD, Portable account, Market-linked returns, Regular pension on retirement

eligibility.description: Indian citizens between 18-70 years, including NRI
additionalCriteria: Must have a valid bank account and Aadhaar
KYC compliance required

applicationProcess: Visit enps.nsdl.com or nearest Point of Presence (PoP)
Fill NPS registration form (online or offline)
Submit KYC documents
Choose investment option (Auto/Active choice) and fund manager
Receive Permanent Retirement Account Number (PRAN)
benefitAmount: Pension corpus based on contributions and returns

name: Atal Pension Yojana
description: Atal Pension Yojana (APY) is aimed at the unorganised sector workers. The scheme provides a defined pension ranging from ₹1,000 to ₹5,000 per month based on contribution, starting at the age of 60 years.
benefits: Guaranteed monthly pension of ₹1,000 to ₹5,000 after age 60; Government co-contribution of 50% for eligible subscribers

eligibility.description: Indian citizens between 18-40 years with a bank account
additionalCriteria: Must have a savings bank account
Must not be an income tax payer (for government co-contribution)
Must not be a member of any statutory social security scheme

applicationProcess: Visit your bank branch or apply through net banking
Fill APY registration form
Set up auto-debit for monthly contributions
Receive APY acknowledgement and account statement

name: PM Mudra Yojana
description: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY) provides loans up to ₹10 lakh to non-corporate, non-farm small/micro enterprises. The scheme has three products — Shishu (up to ₹50,000), Kishore (₹50,001 to ₹5 lakh), and Tarun (₹5 lakh to ₹10 lakh).
benefits: Collateral-free loans up to ₹10 lakh for business purposes at low interest rates

eligibility.description: Non-farm income generating activities in manufacturing, trading, and services sector
additionalCriteria: Must have a business plan
Non-corporate, non-farm enterprise
Valid KYC documents

applicationProcess: Visit nearest bank, MFI, or NBFC
Fill Mudra loan application form
Submit business plan and KYC documents
Bank assesses the application
Loan is disbursed upon approval with Mudra card

name: Beti Bachao Beti Padhao
description: Beti Bachao Beti Padhao (BBBP) scheme aims to address the declining Child Sex Ratio (CSR) and related issues of women empowerment. It promotes the survival, protection, and education of the girl child.
benefits: Awareness campaigns, educational support, financial incentives for girl child education, Prevention of female foeticide

eligibility.description: All families with girl children, specifically targeting states with low Child Sex Ratio
additionalCriteria: Families with girl children
Focus on education of girl child

applicationProcess: Contact nearest Anganwadi centre or CDPO office
Register girl child for scheme benefits
Ensure girl child enrollment in school
Avail benefits through state-specific programs
Contact district Women & Child Development office for specific schemes

name: PM Fasal Bima Yojana
description: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY) provides comprehensive crop insurance to farmers against crop failure due to natural calamities, pests, and diseases. It replaces multiple earlier insurance schemes with a single comprehensive scheme.
benefits: Crop insurance coverage for Kharif (2% premium), Rabi (1.5% premium), and horticultural crops (5% premium). Full coverage for loss due to natural calamities.

eligibility.description: All farmers including sharecroppers and tenant farmers growing notified crops in notified areas
additionalCriteria: Must be growing notified crops
Must apply before cutoff date for the season
Loan-availing farmers are automatically enrolled

applicationProcess: Visit nearest bank, CSC, or insurance company
Fill PMFBY application form
Submit land records and sowing certificate
Pay applicable premium (very low for farmers)
Receive insurance policy document
In case of loss, report to insurance company within 72 hours
benefitAmount: Full crop value insurance at 2-5% premium

name: Standup India
description: Standup India Scheme facilitates bank loans between ₹10 lakh and ₹1 crore to at least one Scheduled Caste (SC) or Scheduled Tribe (ST) borrower and at least one woman borrower per bank branch for setting up a greenfield enterprise.
benefits: Loans from ₹10 lakh to ₹1 crore for setting up new enterprises, composite loan covering 75% of project cost

eligibility.description: SC/ST entrepreneurs and women entrepreneurs above 18 years for greenfield projects
additionalCriteria: Must be SC/ST or woman entrepreneur
Must be setting up a greenfield project
Not in default to any bank or financial institution

applicationProcess: Visit standupmitra.in portal or nearest bank
Register as an entrepreneur
Complete the online application
Submit business plan and required documents
Bank processes and approves the loan
Handholding support provided through SIDBI

name: Digital India Programme
description: Digital India is a flagship programme to transform India into a digitally empowered society and knowledge economy. It focuses on digital infrastructure, digital literacy, and digital services delivery.
benefits: Free digital literacy training, Access to e-governance services, Common Service Centres for digital services, Free WiFi in rural areas

eligibility.description: All Indian citizens, particularly focusing on rural population and economically weaker sections
additionalCriteria: Focus on rural areas and economically weaker sections

applicationProcess: Visit nearest Common Service Centre (CSC)
Enroll for Pradhan Mantri Gramin Digital Saksharta Abhiyan (PMGDISHA)
Complete digital literacy training
Access all e-government services online
Visit digitalindia.gov.in for more information
benefitAmount: Free digital literacy and e-services access

name: National Scholarship Portal
ministry: Ministry of Electronics & IT / Various Ministries
description: National Scholarship Portal (NSP) is a one-stop solution for students seeking scholarships. It hosts various scholarships from central and state governments for students from all classes and categories, from pre-matric to post-doctoral level.
benefits: Various scholarships ranging from ₹1,000 to ₹50,000+ per year for education at different levels

eligibility.description: Students from Class 1 to PhD level; various criteria based on specific scholarship
additionalCriteria: Must be enrolled in a recognized institution
Minimum marks criteria (varies by scheme)
Income limit varies by scholarship

applicationProcess: Visit scholarships.gov.in
Register on NSP with Aadhaar number
Fill the scholarship application form
Upload required documents
Submit application before the deadline
Track application status on the portal

name: PM Vishwakarma Yojana
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises
description: PM Vishwakarma Yojana is launched to support traditional artisans and craftspeople across 18 trades including carpenter, boat maker, blacksmith, mason, basket/mat weaver, toy maker, barber, washerman, tailor, and more.
benefits: Recognition certificate and ID card, Skill upgradation training (₹500/day stipend), Toolkit incentive up to ₹15,000, Collateral-free loans at 5% interest, Digital transactions incentive

eligibility.description: Traditional artisans and craftspeople working in 18 designated trades
additionalCriteria: Must be working in one of the 18 designated trades
Self-employed basis
Not enrolled in other credit-based schemes of central/state government

applicationProcess: Visit nearest Common Service Centre (CSC)
Get registered by Gram Panchayat/ULB verification
Complete skill training at nearest training centre
Receive PM Vishwakarma certificate and ID
Apply for toolkit incentive and loan through portal
Visit pmvishwakarma.gov.in for details
benefitAmount: Loans at 5% interest + ₹15,000 toolkit + training stipend

name: PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana
hindiName: पीएम सूर्य घर मुफ्त बिजली योजना
description: PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana provides subsidy for rooftop solar installations to provide free electricity to households. The scheme aims to provide up to 300 units of free electricity per month to 1 crore households.
benefits: Central subsidy up to ₹78,000 for rooftop solar installation, Up to 300 units free electricity per month, Additional income from surplus electricity sold to DISCOMs

eligibility.description: All households with a valid electricity connection and rooftop space for solar installation
additionalCriteria: Must have a valid electricity connection
Must have roof space suitable for solar panels
Must live in own house

applicationProcess: Visit pmsuryaghar.gov.in
Register with your electricity consumer number
Apply for rooftop solar installation
Get installation done by empanelled vendor
Net meter installation by DISCOM
Receive subsidy in bank account

name: Agnipath Scheme (Agniveer)
description: Agnipath is a recruitment scheme for the armed forces (Army, Navy, Air Force) for a short service period of 4 years. Personnel recruited under this scheme are called Agniveers. After 4 years, 25% are retained for regular service.
benefits: Monthly salary of ₹30,000-₹40,000, Seva Nidhi package of ₹11.71 lakh after 4 years, Risk & Hardship allowances, Medical benefits, Life insurance of ₹48 lakh

eligibility.description: Indian citizens between 17.5 to 21 years (relaxed to 23 years for first batch)
additionalCriteria: Must pass physical fitness test
Must pass medical examination
Educational qualification as per trade requirements
Unmarried at time of enrollment

applicationProcess: Monitor joinindianarmy.nic.in / indiannavy.nic.in / indianairforce.nic.in for vacancies
Apply online during recruitment notification
Appear for written examination
Clear physical fitness test
Medical examination and document verification
Receive appointment letter and join training

name: PM Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana
ministry: Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food & Public Distribution
description: PM Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana (PMGKAY) provides free food grains to beneficiaries covered under the National Food Security Act (NFSA). The scheme now merged with NFSA provides 5 kg of free rice/wheat per person per month.
benefits: 5 kg free food grains (rice/wheat) per person per month through PDS (Public Distribution System)

eligibility.description: All beneficiaries covered under National Food Security Act (NFSA) with valid ration card
additionalCriteria: Must have a valid NFSA ration card (Priority Household or Antyodaya Anna Yojana)
Must be in government database

applicationProcess: Ensure you have a valid NFSA ration card
Visit your designated Fair Price Shop (Ration Shop)
Biometric verification via Aadhaar at ePoS machine
Collect 5 kg free food grains per member
To get a new ration card, visit State Food Department office
benefitAmount: 5 kg free food grains per person per month

name: Ladli Behna Yojana
description: Ladli Behna Yojana is a state scheme by Madhya Pradesh government providing monthly financial assistance to women for their economic independence and health improvement. Similar schemes exist in other states.
benefits: Monthly financial assistance of ₹1,250 (being increased gradually to ₹3,000) directly to women's bank accounts

eligibility.description: Married women of Madhya Pradesh between 21-60 years from lower/middle income families
additionalCriteria: Must be a resident of Madhya Pradesh
Annual family income less than ₹2.5 lakh
Family should not have income tax payer
Family should not have government employee

applicationProcess: Visit nearest Gram Panchayat or Ward Office
Fill Ladli Behna application form
Submit Samagra ID and Aadhaar details
Biometric verification
Submit form and receive acknowledgement
Monthly amount transferred to bank account from 10th of each month
